As carrots are fairly sweet, they can often be used in sweet dishes with good results. One such recipe is '''carrot jam'''; this is a simple version from [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Denmark|Denmark]].

== Ingredients ==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Kilogram|kg]] [[cookbook:carrot|carrot]]s, peeled and finely grated
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Liter|liter]] [[cookbook:water|water]]
* Juice of 4 [[cookbook:lemon|lemon]]s
* ½ kg [[cookbook:sugar|sugar]]

== Procedure ==
# [[cookbook:Boil|Boil]] the water and carrots until tender. 
# Add juice and sugar, and continue to boil for a further 15–20 minutes.
